y-m-08-03.title: Isku xidhidda afargeesooyin leh usha alwaax
y-m-08-03.topic: Xeerka qaabka muuqaalka (sida tirada ushu u koreyso)
y-m-08-03.goal: Dhadhami sida saadaalintu u kala duwan tahay marka ay jiraan laba xog oo keliya iyo marka ay jiraan wax ka badan, oo sharax sababta tirada koraysa marka laga eego sida muuqaaladu isugu xidhmaan.

y-m-08-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Haddii 10 afargeesood la isku xidho hal safka ah, intee usha ayaa jira oo dhan?

y-m-08-01.title: Eegidda tirada tobnaad ee Seojin heshay

y-m-08-10.title: Imisa daqiiqo ilaa shumacu gubto?
y-m-08-10.topic: Xaddi si joogto ah ugu yaraada waqtiga
y-m-08-10.goal: Akhri intee ayaa ku yaraata xad kasta, sida 5 daqiiqo, kala saar tirada xadadka iyo waqtiga marka la helayo wadarta waqtiga, oo fahan in mala-awaalka gubashada joogtada ah uu saameeyo natiijada.
y-m-08-10.material: Shumac 20cm dhererkiisu yahay ayaa la shiday. U malee inuu si joogto ah u yaraanayo 2cm 5 daqiiqo kasta meel dabayl la'aan ah. Jiho wuxuu yiri, "2cm waxay ku habboonaadaan 20cm ee shumaca 10 jeer, sidaa darteed wuxuu gubanayaa 10 daqiiqo!"
y-m-08-10.thinking.0: Helitaanka sadarka xalka halkaas oo cutubyada la isku qasay
y-m-08-10.thinking.1: Samaynta lammaanayaal waqtiyo iyo dhererrada hadhay
y-m-08-10.thinking.2: Dib u eegidda mala-awaalka marka cabbirku ka duwan yahay saadaasha
y-m-08-10.thinking.3: Sheegidda shuruudaha gunaanadka lagu run yahay
y-m-08-10.s.s1.prompt: Dooro sadarka xalka Jiho ee adag in la rumaysto.
y-m-08-10.s.s1.hint.0: Dib u qor tirooyinka sadar kasta adigoo ku lifaaqaya cutubyada (daqiiqo, cm, jeer).
y-m-08-10.s.s1.hint.1: Sadarka 1 hel imisa ayay qaadataa 2cm inay yaraato, oo isbarbar dhig.
y-m-08-10.s.s1.line.2: Sidaa darteed waxay qaadataa 10 daqiiqo si buuxda loo gubo.
y-m-08-10.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 waa khalad. Waxay qaadataa 5 daqiiqo si 2cm u yaraato oo tani waxay dhacdaa 10 jeer, sidaa darteed waqtiga la qaaday waa 5 daqiiqo, 10 jeer. Tani waxay 10 jeer iyo 10 daqiiqo u aragtay isku shay. Sadarrada 1 iyo 2 waa sax.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.prompt: Lammaan u samee dhererka hadhay L (cm) ee shumaca t daqiiqo ka dib marka la shido, oo samee saddex oo waqtiyo kala duwan leh. t waa jibbaar 5 laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 50.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.hint.0: Laga bilaabo 0 daqiiqo, sii wad qorista dhererka hadhay 5 daqiiqo kasta si aad shax u samayso.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.hint.1: Shaxda, hel waqtiga dhererka hadhay uu noqdo 0.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.ok.c1: t waa jibbaar 5 oo ka mid ah 0 ilaa 50.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Fadlan ka dhig t jibbaar 5 oo u dhexeeya 0 iyo 50.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Dhererka hadhay ma sax aha. Sii wad qorista yaraanta 2cm 5 daqiiqo kasta oo hubi.
y-m-08-10.s.s2.explain: t=10 daqiiqo waa 16cm, 25 daqiiqo waa 10cm, 40 daqiiqo waa 4cm, 50 daqiiqo na waa 0cm. Wuxuu yaraadaa 2cm 5 daqiiqo kasta, sidaas darteed waxay qaadataa 50 daqiiqo si 20cm dhammaantood u yaraadaan.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.prompt: Marka runtii la cabbiray, shumaca wuxuu ahaa 10cm 30 daqiiqo ka dib marka la shiday. Sida sharcigu sheegayo waa inuu ahaado 8cm. Dooro wax kasta oo aad samayn karto kiiskan.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore hel inta uu dherer noqon lahaa 30 daqiiqo ka dib sida sharcigu sheegayo.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir kee ayaa shaki leh, qiimaha la cabbiray mise qiimaha sharciga, iyo hubin noocee ah ayaa kuu ogolaan lahayd inaad kala sooctid.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.o.a: Sharcigu waa sax, sidaas darteed gabagabee qiimaha la cabbiray inuu khaldan yahay
y-m-08-10.s.s3.r.a: Fikirkani wuxuu marka hore go'aamiyay qiimaha inuu khaldan yahay ka dib marka uu arkay qiime aan ku habboonayn sharciga.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.o.b: Mar kale cabbir dhererka 30 daqiiqo ka dib.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.r.b: Fikirkani wuxuu isku dayaa inuu hubiyo haddii qiimaha la cabbiray la aamini karo.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.o.c: Eeg haddii waqti u dhexeeya uu ka dhaqso badan ama ka gaabis badan gubtay.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.r.c: Fikirkani wuxuu shakiyaa haddii sharciga laftiisa uu sax ahaa bilowga ilaa dhammaadka.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.o.d: Weli rumayso natiijada ah in lagu gubo 50 daqiiqo hubaal sax tahay.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.r.d: Fikirkani wuxuu isku dayaa inuu ilaaliyo natiijadii ugu horreysay inkasta oo cabbiraad ka duwan tahay saadaasha.
y-m-08-10.s.s3.explain: Marka qiime ka duwan yahay saadaasha, waa inaad eegtaa labadaba haddii qiimaha la cabbiray khaldan yahay iyo haddii sharcigu uusan qabsoomin bilowga ilaa dhammaadka. Waa inaadan marka hore go'aamin in dhinac ka mid ah uu sax yahay. Sidaas darteed natiijada 50 daqiiqo sidoo kale waa qiime shuruud hoostooda "haddii uu si joogto ah u gubto."
y-m-08-10.s.s4.prompt: Qor shuruudda loo baahan yahay si loogu sheego Jiho "waxay qaadataa 50 daqiiqo." Sii hal kiis oo shuruuddaas aan la ilaalin, oo sidoo kale qor waxa ku dhici lahaa waqtiga ay qaadato.
y-m-08-10.s.s4.hint.0: Dib u qor xisaabta si aad u muujiso sida aad u qaadatay shumaca inuu gubto marka aad heshay 50 daqiiqo.
y-m-08-10.s.s4.hint.1: Haddii "2 cm 5 daqiiqo kasta" ee xisaabta lagu isticmaalay aanay isku mid ahayn bilowga ilaa dhammaadka, ka fikir sida waqtiga ay qaadato u is beddeli lahayd.
